actions.amazon_bedrock_converse.descript: Sends a conversation to a Bedrock model and returns its reply.
actions.amazon_bedrock_converse.props.ad: Model-specific parameters Converse does not cover, e.g. {"top_k": 50}.
actions.amazon_bedrock_converse.props.gu: The id or ARN of a guardrail set up in the Amazon Bedrock console, to apply to this call.
The guardrail version, e.g. "1", or "DRAFT". Required with Guardrail ID.
actions.amazon_bedrock_converse.props.ma: The maximum number of tokens to generate.
actions.amazon_bedrock_converse.props.me: Earlier turns as a JSON array of Converse messages, e.g. [{"role": "user", "content": [{"text": "Hi"}]}, {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Hello"}]}]. Use it to send tool results back too.
actions.amazon_bedrock_converse.props.mo: A modelId from List Foundation Models, an inferenceProfileId from List Inference Profiles, a promptRouterArn, or a prompt version ARN from Create Prompt Version.
actions.amazon_bedrock_converse.props.pr: The new user message. Appended after Messages when both are set.
Values for the {{variables}} of a managed prompt, as name → text.
actions.amazon_bedrock_converse.props.st: Strings that stop generation when produced.
actions.amazon_bedrock_converse.props.sy: Instructions that set the model's behaviour.
actions.amazon_bedrock_converse.props.to: Tools the model may call, as a Converse toolConfig object: {"tools": [{"toolSpec": {"name": "...", "description": "...", "inputSchema": {"json": {...}}}}], "toolChoice": {"auto": {}}}.
actions.amazon_bedrock_count_tokens.desc: Counts the input tokens a conversation would use for a model.
actions.amazon_bedrock_count_tokens.prop: Earlier turns as a JSON array of Converse messages, as in Converse.
A foundation modelId from List Foundation Models, e.g. "anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6".
The user message to count. Appended after Messages when both are set.
The system prompt to include in the count.
actions.amazon_bedrock_create_prompt.des: Saves a reusable prompt template in Bedrock Prompt Management.
actions.amazon_bedrock_create_prompt.pro: The maximum number of tokens the model generates.
The model the prompt runs on, a modelId from List Foundation Models or an inferenceProfileId. Required to run the prompt through Converse.
A unique name for the prompt (letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores).
The prompt text. Write each variable in single braces, e.g. "Summarize this ticket in one line: {ticket}"; it is saved as Bedrock's {{ticket}}.
actions.amazon_bedrock_create_prompt_ver: Publishes the current draft of a prompt as a new numbered version.
The id or ARN of the prompt, from Create Prompt or List Prompts.
actions.amazon_bedrock_create_session.de: Starts a Bedrock session that stores conversation state.
actions.amazon_bedrock_create_session.pr: Key-value pairs to store with the session, e.g. {"userId": "123"}. Values are stored as text.
actions.amazon_bedrock_create_session_in: Starts an invocation that groups related steps in a Bedrock session.
What this interaction is about, e.g. "User asking about weather in Seattle".
A UUID to use as the invocation id. Leave empty to let Bedrock generate one.
The sessionId or sessionArn returned by Create Session or List Sessions.
actions.amazon_bedrock_delete_prompt.des: Deletes a prompt, or one published version of it.
actions.amazon_bedrock_delete_prompt.pro: The id or ARN of the prompt, from Create Prompt or List Prompts.
A published version number, e.g. "1", to delete only that version. Leave empty to delete the whole prompt.
actions.amazon_bedrock_delete_session.de: Permanently deletes an ended Bedrock session and its content.
actions.amazon_bedrock_delete_session.pr: The sessionId or sessionArn returned by Create Session or List Sessions.
actions.amazon_bedrock_end_session.descr: Ends a Bedrock session so nothing more can be added to it.
actions.amazon_bedrock_end_session.props: The sessionId or sessionArn returned by Create Session or List Sessions.
actions.amazon_bedrock_get_foundation_mo: Gets the details of one foundation model.
The modelId or modelArn returned by List Foundation Models, e.g. "amazon.nova-micro-v1:0".
Checks whether the account can use a foundation model in the connected region.
The modelId returned by List Foundation Models, e.g. "amazon.nova-micro-v1:0".
actions.amazon_bedrock_get_inference_pro: Gets the details of one inference profile.
The inferenceProfileId or inferenceProfileArn returned by List Inference Profiles.
actions.amazon_bedrock_get_model_invocat: Reads where the account logs model invocations in the connected region.
actions.amazon_bedrock_get_prompt.descri: Gets one prompt from Bedrock Prompt Management.
The id or ARN of the prompt, from Create Prompt or List Prompts.
A published version number, e.g. "1", from Create Prompt Version. Leave empty for the working DRAFT.
actions.amazon_bedrock_get_prompt_router: Gets the details of one prompt router.
The promptRouterArn returned by List Prompt Routers.
actions.amazon_bedrock_get_session.descr: Gets the details of one Bedrock session.
actions.amazon_bedrock_get_session.props: The sessionId or sessionArn returned by Create Session or List Sessions.
actions.amazon_bedrock_get_session_invoc: Gets one stored step, with its text and images, from a Bedrock session.
The invocationId returned by Create Session Invocation or List Session Invocations.
The invocationStepId returned by Put Session Invocation Step or List Session Invocation Steps.
The sessionId or sessionArn returned by Create Session or List Sessions.
actions.amazon_bedrock_invoke_model.desc: Calls a Bedrock model with its own native JSON request body.
actions.amazon_bedrock_invoke_model.prop: The model's native request body, e.g. {"inputText": "hello"} for Titan Text Embeddings V2, or {"messages": [...], "max_tokens": 512, "anthropic_version": "bedrock-2023-05-31"} for Anthropic models.
The id or ARN of a guardrail set up in the Amazon Bedrock console, to apply to this call.
The guardrail version, e.g. "1", or "DRAFT". Required with Guardrail ID.
A modelId from List Foundation Models or an inferenceProfileId from List Inference Profiles.
actions.amazon_bedrock_list_enforced_gua: Lists the guardrails the account enforces on every model call.
The nextToken from a previous call, to get the next page.
actions.amazon_bedrock_list_foundation_m: Lists the foundation models offered in the connected AWS region.
Only models that support this kind of customization.
Only models that support this inference type.
Only models that produce this kind of output.
Only models from this provider, e.g. "Amazon", "Anthropic", "Meta", "Mistral AI", "Cohere".
actions.amazon_bedrock_list_inference_pr: Lists the inference profiles in the connected region.
Maximum number of profiles to return (1–1000). Defaults to 50.
The nextToken from a previous call, to get the next page.
Only profiles of this type. Leave empty for both.
actions.amazon_bedrock_list_prompt_route: Lists the prompt routers in the connected region.
Maximum number of routers to return (1–1000). Defaults to 50.
The nextToken from a previous call, to get the next page.
Only routers of this type. Leave empty for both.
actions.amazon_bedrock_list_prompts.desc: Lists the prompts saved in Bedrock Prompt Management.
actions.amazon_bedrock_list_prompts.prop: Maximum number of prompts to return (1–1000). Defaults to 50.
The nextToken from a previous call, to get the next page.
The id or ARN of a prompt, from Create Prompt or List Prompts, to list its versions. Leave empty to list all prompts.
actions.amazon_bedrock_list_session_invo: Lists the steps stored in a Bedrock session, optionally for one invocation.
Only steps of this invocation: an invocationId from Create Session Invocation or List Session Invocations. Leave empty for every step in the session.
Maximum number of results to return (1–1000). Defaults to 50.
The nextToken from a previous call, to get the next page.
The sessionId or sessionArn returned by Create Session or List Sessions.
Lists the invocations stored in a Bedrock session.
Maximum number of results to return (1–1000). Defaults to 50.
The nextToken from a previous call, to get the next page.
The sessionId or sessionArn returned by Create Session or List Sessions.
actions.amazon_bedrock_list_sessions.des: Lists the Bedrock sessions in the connected region.
actions.amazon_bedrock_list_sessions.pro: Maximum number of results to return (1–1000). Defaults to 50.
The nextToken from a previous call, to get the next page.
actions.amazon_bedrock_optimize_prompt.d: Rewrites a prompt to work better with a chosen model.
actions.amazon_bedrock_optimize_prompt.p: The modelId from List Foundation Models to optimize the prompt for, e.g. "anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620-v1:0".
actions.amazon_bedrock_put_session_invoc: Stores a step of text and images in a Bedrock session invocation.

Advanced: more content blocks as a JSON array, sent after Text. Each is {"text": "..."} or {"image": {"format": "png" | "jpeg" | "gif" | "webp", "source": {"s3Location": {"uri": "s3://bucket/key"}}}}; use {"bytes": "<base64>"} as the source for inline images.
The invocationId returned by Create Session Invocation or List Session Invocations.
A UUID to use as the step id. Leave empty to let Bedrock generate one.
When the step happened. Defaults to now.
The sessionId or sessionArn returned by Create Session or List Sessions.
The text to store as this step. Sent as the first content block.
actions.amazon_bedrock_update_prompt.des: Changes the working draft of a saved prompt.
actions.amazon_bedrock_update_prompt.pro: A new description of what the prompt is for.
The maximum number of tokens the model generates.
The model the prompt runs on, a modelId from List Foundation Models or an inferenceProfileId.
A new unique name for the prompt (letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores).
The id or ARN of the prompt, from Create Prompt or List Prompts.
The new prompt text, replacing the current one. Write each variable in single braces, e.g. "Summarize this ticket in one line: {ticket}"; it is saved as Bedrock's {{ticket}}.
actions.amazon_bedrock_update_session.de: Replaces the metadata stored with a Bedrock session.
actions.amazon_bedrock_update_session.pr: The full set of key-value pairs to store with the session, e.g. {"userId": "123"}. Replaces the existing metadata. Values are stored as text.
The sessionId or sessionArn returned by Create Session or List Sessions.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to any AWS Bedrock endpoint. Requests are automatically signed with AWS Signature V4.
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: When enabled, errors (e.g. 4xx/5xx responses) are returned as output instead of stopping the flow. Useful when you want to handle errors in a later step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Additional headers to include. Authorization headers are automatically added via AWS Signature V4.
actions.custom_api_call.props.method.des: HTTP method for the request. Use GET to fetch data, POST/PUT to create or update, DELETE to remove.
actions.custom_api_call.props.path.descr: The API path (e.g., /foundation-models, /model/{modelId}/invoke). See the AWS Bedrock API Reference for available endpoints.
actions.custom_api_call.props.queryParam: Query parameters to include in the request URL.
actions.custom_api_call.props.service.de: Select the AWS Bedrock service endpoint to call. Use "Bedrock" for control plane operations (e.g., ListFoundationModels) and "Bedrock Runtime" for inference operations (e.g., InvokeModel).
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: How long to wait for a response before the request is cancelled. Defaults to 30 seconds.
actions.generate_content_from_image.desc: Ask a Bedrock model a question about an image.
actions.generate_content_from_image.prop: The maximum number of tokens to generate.
The foundation model to use. Must support image input.
What do you want the model to tell you about the image?
Choose how to provide the image — upload directly or reference one already in S3.
Instructions that guide the model behavior.
Controls randomness. Lower values produce more deterministic output.
actions.generate_embeddings.description: Generate vector embeddings from text using Amazon Titan Embed, Cohere Embed, or Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings models.
actions.generate_embeddings.props.dimens: Size of the output vector. Larger = more accurate but slower/costlier. Titan Embed v2 supports: 256, 512, 1024. Nova Multimodal supports: 256, 384, 1024, 3072. Leave blank to use the model default.
actions.generate_embeddings.props.embedd: How the embeddings will be used — helps the model optimize the output. Only applies to Nova Multimodal Embeddings models. Leave as "Generic Index" if unsure.
actions.generate_embeddings.props.inputT: The text to generate embeddings for.
actions.generate_embeddings.props.normal: Scale the output vector so its values range between -1 and 1. Recommended for similarity comparisons. Only supported by Titan Embed v2.
actions.generate_image.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using Amazon Titan Image Generator or Stability AI models.
actions.generate_image.props.height.desc: Image height in pixels. Must be supported by the model.
actions.generate_image.props.model.descr: The image generation model to use.
actions.generate_image.props.negativePro: Describe what you do NOT want in the image. Helps refine the output.
actions.generate_image.props.prompt.desc: A text description of the image you want to generate.
actions.generate_image.props.seed.descri: A seed for reproducible results. Use the same seed and prompt to get the same image.
actions.generate_image.props.width.descr: Image width in pixels. Must be supported by the model.
actions.send_prompt.description: Send a text prompt to an Amazon Bedrock model.
actions.send_prompt.props.attachmentSour: Optionally include a file alongside your prompt. Choose whether to upload directly or reference one from S3.
actions.send_prompt.props.maxTokens.desc: The maximum length of the response. One token is roughly 4 characters. 2048 tokens ≈ ~1500 words.
actions.send_prompt.props.memoryKey.desc: A unique name for this conversation's memory (e.g. "support-chat-user-123"). When set, the model remembers previous messages in this flow. Leave empty for a single-turn interaction with no memory.
actions.send_prompt.props.model.descript: The foundation model to use for generation.
actions.send_prompt.props.prompt.descrip: The message or question to send to the model.
Text strings that, when generated, cause the model to stop immediately (e.g. "END" or "\n\n"). Up to 4 sequences.
actions.send_prompt.props.systemPrompt.d: Instructions that set the model's behavior and persona (e.g. "You are a helpful assistant that replies concisely.").
actions.send_prompt.props.temperature.de: Controls how creative or predictable the response is. Lower values (e.g. 0.2) give focused, consistent answers. Higher values (e.g. 0.9) give more varied, creative output.
actions.send_prompt.props.topP.descripti: Limits the pool of words the model picks from (0–1). Lower values make responses more focused. Leave at 1 to disable this filter and use Temperature instead.
description: Build generative AI applications with foundation models
